message.content:
Comment-only fix on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`. Marcel has decided: the implementation stays exactly as shipped (Wishlist's hover reveal, Home's badge/hover-swap suppression) — only remove the false/invented citations that were used to justify those calls without properly escalating them. Do not touch `VARIATION_CONFIG` or any other logic — this is a docblock edit only.

**File:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.tsx` — its module-level docblock (read the whole thing first, roughly the first ~135 lines).

**Two specific problems to fix:**

1. One passage cites AGENTS.md's doc-integrity rule as justification for silently picking the Figma design over the Jira AC's literal text (regarding Wishlist's hover reveal scope). That citation is wrong — AGENTS.md's actual doc-integrity rule says the opposite: pause and ask when a design and a written requirement conflict, don't silently pick one. Remove this citation. Do not replace it with a different invented justification — just state plainly, factually, what was built and why (the design showed X, the AC said Y, this shipped matching the design) without claiming a rule authorizes resolving that silently. It's fine for the comment to say this was a judgment call made during build that hasn't been separately ratified — that's honest; inventing a rule that says otherwise is not.

2. A separate passage states *"the confirmed authority order (comments > ACs > designs)"* as if it's established, pre-agreed policy. It isn't — it was coined in this same file. Remove the phrase "confirmed authority order" and any framing that presents it as pre-existing policy. You may keep the underlying fact (Dani's comment was treated as more authoritative than the AC text for the Home badge/hover-swap suppression) stated plainly as what was done, without dressing it up as an established rule.

**What must NOT change:** any Figma node ID, any Jira comment number, any factual claim about what the design/AC/comment actually say, the `VARIATION_CONFIG` object or any other code, the recently-added "KNOWN GAP" paragraph about the Recently Viewed carousel (leave that exactly as-is — it's unrelated to this fix and already correct).

Match this file's own existing voice — direct, cites specifics, doesn't hedge unnecessarily, but this time doesn't claim authority it doesn't have.

When done, quote the exact before/after of both passages you changed, and confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean. Do not stage, do not commit.
